prompts.title: Recent Form
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16 motion scene, about 8 seconds, on GoatLab charcoal #101412. Three category groups sit on one shared zero baseline — 'Victorias', 'Empates', 'Derrotas' (Spanish labels) — each group holding two bars: Manchester United FC in lime #c5ed74 and AFC Bournemouth in slate #8ca6bf. Bar heights resolve from {{home.wins}}, {{home.draws}} and {{home.losses}} for the home series and {{away.wins}}, {{away.draws}} and {{away.losses}} for the away series, all in the unit 'partidos'. Because the two series may come from unequal samples, print each team's own sample caption under its color chip — 'Muestra: {{home.n}} partidos' and 'Muestra: {{away.n}} partidos' — and, if the windows differ, add a thin dashed note 'Muestras distintas'. A small source caption in warm white #edf0e6, 'Fuente' plus the provider credit from the fact metadata, sits at the chart's base. Typography: condensed grotesque, team names at title weight, category labels legible at mobile size. Temporal stages: 0–1.5s title 'FORMA RECIENTE' snaps in; 1.5–4.5s bars rise from the baseline with a soft overshoot; 4.5–6.5s a lime outline pulses around the tallest bar as the single emphasis beat; 6.5–8s hold. Camera: slow push-in, no pan. Exit: bars retract to the baseline and the chart wipes upward.
